ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 45 percent low-intensity (black) and 55 percent high-intensity (white) pixel coverage across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black contiguous mass extending from the peduncle to the median notch; wide black bands along the trailing edges; lower lobe regions primarily white with dense, jagged black linear and mottled streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex and high pixel-depth relative to width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrations; left lobe features frequent fine-grain peaks; right lobe features broader, rounded undulating scalloped valleys with higher pixel-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curve sweeping from the central notch toward the distal tips, which exhibit rounded termination.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white/gray textured pixel clusters on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; one distinct dark circular focal spot in the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely packed, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small circular void or dark puncture mark visible in the upper-mid region of the right lobe; extensive linear rake-mark trauma across both ventral surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark ring-shaped pigmentation mark located on the outer portion of the right lobe near the trailing edge.
